summary: Global Pi agent at ~/.pi/agent is extension-rich (18 packages, local guards) but rules-thin: no AGENTS.md despite Pi loading it first, only APPEND_SYSTEM.md (~1KB CE-lite routing). Skills filter is a hard allowlist (ce-lite + better-harness) over 48 on-disk skills (39 disable-model-invocation); last30days SKILL.md is 222KB. harness-inventory.json is stale vs settings. pi-essentials is registered both via packages and settings.extensions (double-load risk). Memory and Explore subagent are solid baselines.

findings.title: Missing global AGENTS.md (Pi load order #1)
evidence: No ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md, SYSTEM.md, or CLAUDE.md. Pi platform doc loads global AGENTS.md first. Only APPEND_SYSTEM.md exists (1081 bytes): CE-lite routing, workflow triggers, terse style rules. Project AGENTS.md files exist under ~/Projects/* but do not substitute for the global agent file.
findings.fixDirection: Create ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md with durable global defaults: identity/operating style, when to read ce-lite, tool-surface preferences (ctx_* / lean-ctx), safety boundaries, and pointers to memory/. Keep APPEND_SYSTEM.md as short always-on steers or merge into AGENTS.md if Pi does not natively load APPEND_SYSTEM.

findings.title: harness-inventory.json stale vs live settings
evidence: Inventory generatedAt 2026-07-30T14:52:23Z lists defaultModel Venice/kimi-k2.5 and a short packages list. Live settings.json has defaultModel grok-4-5, defaultProvider Venice, 18 packages (incl. pi-lean-ctx, context-mode, pi-dynamic-workflows, better-harness, last30days-pi, pi-essentials), skills allowlist [!** , **/ce-lite/** , **/better-harness/**], compaction reserveTokens 24000 / keepRecentTokens 20000.
findings.fixDirection: Regenerate harness-inventory.json from current settings + on-disk scan (packages, extensions, skills filter, agents, memory). Add a doctor/hook step so inventory cannot drift more than one session behind settings.

findings.title: pi-essentials double-registration via packages and settings.extensions
evidence: packages includes npm:@samfp/pi-essentials (package.json pi.extensions lists 10 entrypoints). settings.extensions also lists 6 of those same files under ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/@samfp/pi-essentials/src/* plus local transcript-pruner.ts. Risk: duplicate handlers for session-name/title/prune/clipboard on load.
findings.fixDirection: Pick one registration path. Prefer packages-only for pi-essentials and keep settings.extensions for local-only files (transcript-pruner.ts, any path not in a package pi key). Verify load once after change.

findings.title: Skills disk catalog rot under intentional allowlist
evidence: settings.skills = [!** , **/ce-lite/** , **/better-harness/**]. On disk: 48 skill dirs under ~/.pi/agent/skills; 39 SKILL.md set disable-model-invocation: true. Only ce-lite matches local allow path; better-harness comes from package path. Package-declared skills (context-mode ~8, pi-autoresearch, workflow-authoring/patterns, last30days-pi) are also denied by !** unless path matches allow globs. leadSummaryFacts.usageActivity.skills.total = 0.
findings.fixDirection: Either (1) archive/remove unused skill dirs into a cold store and document the allowlist policy in AGENTS.md, or (2) widen allow globs only for skills that must be model-selectable (e.g. workflow-authoring, harness-doctor) and keep the rest slash-only/dmi. Do not leave 48 live dirs if only two patterns are intentional.

findings.title: last30days SKILL.md fails progressive disclosure (222KB)
evidence: skills/last30days/SKILL.md is 221800 bytes; skill dir ~19MB. skill-eval progressive-disclosure guidance expects thin SKILL.md with refs. Skill is currently filter-blocked but still pollutes inventory and any future allowlist mistake would dump huge body into context.
findings.fixDirection: Split to a short SKILL.md (name/description/when-to-use + steps) and move bulk into references/. Prefer package skill at git/github.com/gvkhosla/last30days-pi/pi-skills over a duplicated fat local copy, or delete the local duplicate if package path is canonical.

findings.title: No user-level prompts/ library
evidence: No ~/.pi/agent/prompts directory. Only package prompt found: better-harness/prompts/Better-harness.md. Recurring workflows (review, research brief, invest posture) have no slash-prompt surface at user level.
findings.fixDirection: Add ~/.pi/agent/prompts/ for high-frequency slash templates (e.g. code-review, research-brief, portfolio-check) that expand to structured instructions without opening full skills.

findings.title: Subagent fleet is a single Explore specialist
evidence: agents/ contains only Explore.md (2205 bytes): read-only search agent, tools read/bash/grep/find/ls, model Venice/gemini-3-5-flash, prompt_mode replace, glla-managed pin note. No planner/reviewer/implementer/verifier agents. Subagent runtime also provided by pi-essentials.
findings.fixDirection: Keep Explore as leaf search. Add 1–2 named agents only if usage shows repeated multi-role fan-out (e.g. reviewer with git-diff scope, or implementer with write tools). Avoid fleet sprawl.

findings.title: Package skills likely invisible under !** allowlist
evidence: APPEND_SYSTEM tells agents to read pi-dynamic-workflows workflow-authoring skill before custom scripts; package declares skills workflow-authoring and workflow-patterns. context-mode declares ./skills (ctx-doctor, ctx-index, …). skills filter starts with !** so these paths do not match **/ce-lite/** or **/better-harness/** and are excluded from the skill catalog.
findings.fixDirection: Add explicit allow globs for required package skills (e.g. **/workflow-authoring/** , **/workflow-patterns/** , **/context-mode/**/skills/**) or document that those flows must use direct path reads / slash commands only. Align APPEND_SYSTEM claims with filter reality.

findings.title: Memory surface present and populated
evidence: memory/ has consolidated.md (7903B), harnesses.md (2591B), user-shell.md (357B), plus better-harness/ run artifacts. daily-log available via pi-essentials package entry.
findings.fixDirection: Reference memory/ from AGENTS.md (when to read consolidated vs harnesses). Keep better-harness artifacts out of always-on context; load on demand.

findings.title: Allowed orchestrator skill ce-lite is well-structured
evidence: ce-lite SKILL.md ~4892B, disable-model-invocation absent (model-selectable), clear description, progressive refs under skills/ce-lite/references/, workflow routing. APPEND_SYSTEM always-on pointer matches allowlist. Counter-example: grill-me SKILL.md is a 297B stub with disable-model-invocation true.
findings.fixDirection: Treat ce-lite as canonical entry skill. Promote any newly allowed skill to the same progressive-disclosure bar before adding allow globs.

findings.title: Local extension + package stack is capability-heavy
evidence: Local extensions/: goal-list-loop-audit.ts, glla-subagent-strategy-guard.ts, invest-optimizer/ (tools), transcript-pruner.ts. Packages resolve all 18 entries with pi keys (lean-ctx, cache-optimizer, continue, model-agents/thinking, dynamic-workflows, context-mode, last30days-pi, better-harness, etc.). Compaction configured. Architecture envelopes empty so this pass rebuilt inventory from disk.
findings.fixDirection: After fixing double-registration (C3), document the extension intent map in AGENTS.md or harness-inventory (why each package is installed). Prune packages with no observed session value.

architectureEnvelopes.note: Pass C rebuilt light inventory from disk; did not execute extensions

Highest-leverage fixes: write AGENTS.md (C1), refresh harness-inventory (C2), dedupe pi-essentials registration (C3), reconcile skills filter with package skills referenced by APPEND_SYSTEM (C8).
